num_tasks: <int> Total number of trips (tasks) that must be covered by vehicles.
num_depots: <int> Total number of depots from which vehicles can be dispatched.
num_compatible_pairs: <int> Total number of feasible consecutive trip pairs where a vehicle can travel from one trip to the next in time.
num_arcs: <int> Total number of arcs in the network including depot-to-task, task-to-task, and task-to-depot connections.
time_horizon: <int> Length of the scheduling day in minutes.
depot_penalty: <int> Fixed cost penalty added to each vehicle used, representing the cost of dispatching a vehicle from a depot.

depots.capacity: <int> Maximum number of vehicles that can be dispatched from this depot.

tasks.start_time: <float> Scheduled departure time of the trip in minutes from the start of the day.
tasks.end_time: <float> Scheduled arrival time of the trip in minutes from the start of the day.
tasks.duration: <float> Duration of the trip in minutes.
tasks.start_x: <float> X-coordinate of the trip's origin location.
tasks.start_y: <float> Y-coordinate of the trip's origin location.
tasks.end_x: <float> X-coordinate of the trip's destination location.
tasks.end_y: <float> Y-coordinate of the trip's destination location.

compatible_pairs.task_i: <int> Identifier of the earlier trip in the feasible consecutive pair.
compatible_pairs.task_j: <int> Identifier of the later trip in the feasible consecutive pair.
compatible_pairs.travel_time: <float> Deadhead travel time in minutes for a vehicle to reposition from the end of task_i to the start of task_j.
compatible_pairs.cost: <float> Cost of the deadhead travel from the end of task_i to the start of task_j.

depot_to_task_costs.depot_id: <int> Identifier of the depot from which the vehicle departs.
depot_to_task_costs.task_id: <int> Identifier of the first trip the vehicle serves after leaving the depot.
depot_to_task_costs.travel_time: <float> Deadhead travel time in minutes from the depot to the start of the task.
depot_to_task_costs.cost: <float> Total pull-out cost including the depot penalty and deadhead travel from the depot to the task.

task_to_depot_costs.task_id: <int> Identifier of the last trip the vehicle serves before returning to the depot.
task_to_depot_costs.depot_id: <int> Identifier of the depot to which the vehicle returns.
task_to_depot_costs.travel_time: <float> Deadhead travel time in minutes from the end of the task back to the depot.
task_to_depot_costs.cost: <float> Total pull-in cost including the depot penalty and deadhead travel from the task to the depot.
